verses.1: And Joshua sent two men, who were strong and brave, to go and see the land and its people. They went there, and they entered the house of a woman named Rahab. She was a wicked woman, but they slept in her house.
verses.2: And he said to the king of Jericho, “Look! These people have come here this evening from among the Israelites, in order to plunder this land.”
verses.3: And the king of Jericho sent someone to Rahab, saying, “Bring out those people who have come to you. For I want to take possession of all this land.”
verses.4: And the woman took the two men and watched them. Then she said, “These men have come to me. But I didn’t know from where they came.”
verses.5: And the gate became closed in the darkness. The people rushed out. I didn’t know where they were going. The people rushed after them, trying to catch up to them.
verses.6: And she covered them with leaves from the tall trees, so that they would be covered by those leaves on the branches.
verses.7: And the men pursued them along the Jordan River, through the bridges. The gates were closed after the pursuers left.
verses.8: And before they could lie down, she stood on top of them, on their backs.
verses.9: And he said to the people, “I know that Jehovah has given you this land. Your enemies have fallen upon us, and all those who live in this land have been destroyed by you.”
verses.10: For we have heard that the Lord has dried up the sea before you as you left Egypt. And you also did what was right in doing to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, at Sihon and Og. You defeated them completely.
verses.11: And we heard that he would come to us. But no wind blew over any of you people. For Jehovah your God is the God who rules over heaven above and over the earth below.
verses.12: And now, please return to me in the name of Jehovah. For I have done kindnesses with you, and you too have done kindnesses towards my father’s house. You have given me truth.
verses.13: And they saved my father and mother, as well as my brothers and sisters. They also saved all those who belonged to them. They rescued our lives from death.
verses.14: And they said to her, “Our souls are in your hands; we will die if you do not tell us what we need to know. Then, it would be a sin against Jehovah for us to give up this land. But we have done you a favor and spoken truth to you.”
verses.15: And she went along the path, near the stream. Her house was located on the wall of the city. And in that city, she lived.
verses.16: And the mountain said to them, “Go away! Otherwise, your pursuers will catch you. Stay there for three days until the pursuers leave. Then you can continue on your way.”
verses.17: And they said to her, “The men are pure. We are free from your sinfulness, for you have blessed us.”
verses.18: See, we are now coming to this land. This is the second year that we will be united with you in this place where we were brought. I will gather your father, your mother, your brothers, and all those who belong to your family, and bring them to me.
verses.19: And everything that comes out of the chambers of your house will be clean and pure. Everything that is in your house will also be pure, if there’s a hand involved in it.
verses.20: And if you tell us this, then we will be pure from your “shavuot” that you have given us.
verses.21: And he said, “As you have said.” Then he sent them away. They went away, and they completed the second year of their journey.
verses.22: And they went and arrived at the mountain. They stayed there for three days, until the pursuers came back. But the pursuers searched everywhere, yet they couldn’t find them.
verses.23: And the two men returned down from the mountain. They went through the pass and arrived at Jehoshua ben Nun. They told him everything they had found.
verses.24: And they said to Joshua, “Since Jehovah has given us all this land in our hands, then let us also drive out all the inhabitants of this land from before us.”
